summary: Alberta's register dates the Moberly cabin to 1967; the only firsthand account is a 2014 trip report, and no source describes the site today.

access.note: Alberta says the public may not climb lookout towers and lookout dwellings are for private use. The register codes the site as drive access. No source describes its access today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register codes the site as drive access, but the 2014 trip report found the access road unmaintained and beyond the writer's car. Both are reported; neither is treated as current.

sources.title: Wildfire Lookouts of Alberta (WF_WILDFIRE_LOOKOUT), FIRES database extract

notes_for_editor: Register values (YEAR_CONSTRUCTED 1967, TOWER_HEIGHT 5.0, ELEVATION 1676.2, ACCESS_MODE drive, ACTIVE Y) come from the public query on the Alberta lookout layer, the same way the Athabasca record sourced its year. That layer's metadata labels the dataset Protected, so the editor should confirm these values may be published. Status 'standing' rests only on the 2014 trip report; no later source describes the site. The brief's access 'closed' is not stated by any source read, so it is recorded as restricted, as in the Athabasca record. Two searches and the page reads found nothing on staffing or fires.
